minor.issue: Sets token_cfg.<mint> to the whole object sent, so a later {mint:{tp_pct:X}} wipes a sl_pct already saved for the SAME mint. Overrides for other mints are kept. The UI always sends both values, so users don't see it today. Fix: set token_cfg.<mint>.tp_pct and token_cfg.<mint>.sl_pct as separate fields.

If TP/SL hits while the wallet holds tokens but the sell keeps failing (e.g. no SOL for fees, no route), the position is not cleared. So a REJECTED bot_log is written every 5s with no limit (log spam). Add a backoff, or mark the position after a failed attempt.
Mint keys are only checked for length (32-44), then used inside a Mongo dotted path. A key with '.' or '$' would create nested fields or fail. Check keys against the base58 alphabet.
Old DuplicateKeyError tracebacks on bots.user_id_1 in backend.err.log, from concurrent first-time get_bot inserts. Not new this iteration.
